item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 1 in 4 former NFL players who died from 2016 to 2021 had CTE, study estimates
item.description: At least 1 in 4 former National Football League players who died between 2016 and 2021 had chronic traumatic encephalopathy, according to a study released on Tuesday in the journal BMJ.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Judge rejects Ghislaine Maxwell's bid to overturn sex trafficking conviction
item.description: A federal judge rejected Ghislaine Maxwell’s bid to overturn her sex trafficking conviction, calling her claims “speculation” and “falsehoods.”
